title: Picky Eating in Toddlers: Gentle Ways to Offer New Foods Without Pressure
description: Lots of toddlers turn down a new food many times before they try it. title: Toddler and Baby Transition Tips: Tell Them What Comes Next
description: Before you pick up a baby, say it out loud, “I'm going to pick you up now,” and wait a second so they can get ready.
